project.title: Universal Field Prop Lighting Control System

history.summary: Initial baseline release of universal field prop lighting platform: Synapse Master Console, Peripheral Prop Receiver & Driver Node, pilot kit BOM (1 Synapse + 3 Peripherals), 30-prop fleet purchasing schedule, and zero-code seasonal show reprogramming software architecture.

Update Peripheral Prop Receiver carrier board (PCB-PROP-NODE-V1) to 8-bit DIP switch bank (CTS 208-8 / CT2088-ND) providing 256 unique hardware device serial IDs. Document Distributed Timeline Architecture with 40 MHz quartz phase-locked clock sync and dual-path spare unit re-mapping protocol.

Transition carrier boards (PCB-SYNAPSE-V1 and PCB-PROP-NODE-V1) to 100% pluggable 5.08mm terminal blocks (Phoenix Contact COMBICON MSTBA / 2EDG-5.08). Implement 32 dedicated terminals on Synapse master controller providing individual [Signal | Ground] pairs per button sinking into PCB ground plane for tool-free field disconnection and 60-second button replacements. Preserve placed DigiKey order by sourcing pluggable kits via Amazon Prime.
